user.title: Add a QUBO device
user.description: Find your QUBO smart plug or air purifier on your MQTT broker, or enter its details yourself.

manual.title: Enter device details
manual.description: Copy these values from the device's heartbeat message on your MQTT broker.

data_description.device_name: A name for the device in Home Assistant
data_description.device_mac: Optional. The part of `srcDeviceId` after the underscore
data_description.device_type: `HSP_` devices are smart plugs, `HPH_` devices are air purifiers

progress.discovering: Listening for QUBO devices on MQTT for 30 seconds…

error.no_devices_found: No new QUBO devices were heard. Check that the device is connected to your broker, or enter its details below.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up
